newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher on stocks, contract highs.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher on stocks, contract highs.

text.p: A cut by USDA in its estimate for 1996-97 U.S. rice ending stocks and a reduction in the amount of rice registered for potential delivery on the CBOT boosted CBOT rice futures to a higher close, traders said.
Contract highs were set in all months with LFG Futures the key buyer, sources said.
"It followed the bullish report and cash is still firm in the country," a trader said.
USDA Friday estimated U.S. 1996-97 U.S. rice ending stocks at 25.3 million cwt, below the previous government for 25.6 million.
Also the CBOT late Thursday showed rice registrations at 1.6 million cwt, below the roughly 2.0 million late Wednesday.
The new contract high for January is $11.32 per cwt, up from the previous high of $11.24 set Wednesday.
Rice closed 18 to 20 cents per cwt higher, with January up 18 at $11.32 per cwt.
